gen-gf-baumans-gf-mona-sans: Baumans bends its round letters like wire, every stroke the same weight. Mona Sans sits beneath with wide-open letter shapes, giving that bold-looking top line a plain, easygoing partner for the running text.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-monda: Approachable Monda keeps its small counters unclogged and friendly, which gives Baumans, with its wrench-wide c, a clear job to stand against. Baumans grabs attention; Monda does the explaining.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-mooli: Mooli reads crisply, its round open letters staying clear even when the text gets small. Mooli then carries a long stretch comfortably, while Baumans, a rope-thin outline of a display face, stays up top making the statement.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-murecho: Baumans draws every glyph with a single thickness, and its c opens like a crescent wrench. Baumans makes the statement; Murecho's wide-ended s curves handle the talking.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-nanum-gothic: Commanding Baumans leads with joins as thick as its strokes, while Nanum Gothic lets wide channels run into every counter. Nudge Nanum Gothic up if the text feels tight.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-national-park: Baumans has a wrench-wide c and no change in stroke thickness anywhere. National Park matches that steadiness with rounded letters and one clearly open side, and that shared constancy is what holds the pair together.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-niramit: Niramit's curves gape open, giving text a bright, clean look. Baumans, with its bent-tubing letterforms, does the shouting, and Niramit does the quiet, careful explaining.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-canadian-abo: Baumans has no tapering at all, as if a quill never changed pressure, and its c gapes like a wrench. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal brings openness at every curve end, so the pair feels distinctive up top and unfussy below.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-cypriot: Marker-plain and bold-faced, Baumans looks hand-drawn without trying. Noto Sans Cypriot opens its e up instead of closing the eye, so the heading and the text read as one friendly, uncomplicated voice.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Baumans runs a single flat line weight through every glyph, with a c opened like a wrench. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave big gaps, so longer text moves along easily.
